entities.name: Proteasome-activating nucleotidase PAN
observations: 436 aa archaeal AAA+ ATPase with an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q8TX03 from Methanopyrus kandleri.
Contains an N-terminal coiled-coil region and AAA+ ATPase domains, including Prot_ATP_ID_OB and AAA/AAA-lid regions.
Functions as the proteasome regulatory ATPase that recognizes, unfolds, and translocates substrate proteins into the archaeal 20S proteasome.
ATP hydrolysis reaction: ATP + H2O -> ADP + phosphate + H+; mapped to Rhea RHEA:13065.
Forms a homohexameric two-ring complex that caps the 20S proteasome; its C-terminal tail docks into alpha-ring pockets to open the proteasome gate.
Annotated to cytoplasm, ATP binding, ATP hydrolysis, protein unfolding, and proteasomal protein catabolic process.

entities.name: Archaeal 20S proteasome
observations: PAN regulates access to the proteolytic chamber by docking its C-terminal residues into alpha-ring intersubunit pockets and inducing gate opening.

entities.name: RHEA:13065
observations: ATP + H2O = ADP + phosphate + H+; reaction assigned to proteasome-activating nucleotidase PAN.
